type mapping

// require raylib                  every function, struct and enum below
// require raylib/raylib_boost     also the color constants and the enum overloads

Vector2, Vector3, Vector4   -> float2, float3, float4
Quaternion                  -> float4
Rectangle                   -> float4       // x, y, width, height
Color (by value)            -> float4       // RGBA in 0..1, converted to bytes for you
Matrix (by value)           -> float4x4     // converted for you
Color, Matrix (in pointers and struct fields) stay raw: use the converters
const char *                -> string
T *                         -> T?

// float4 is both Color and Rectangle: the parameter name tells you which.
// Enum parameters are plain int unless a raylib_boost overload is listed.
// raygui text boxes write to their text, so pass text_buffer(), not a string.

// Font Loading and Text Drawing Functions

// Font loading/unloading functions

def IsFontValid(font : Font) : bool                                         // Check if font is valid (font data loaded, WARNING: GPU texture not checked)

def LoadUTF8(codepoints : int const?; length : int) : string         // Load UTF-8 text encoded from codepoints array
def UnloadUTF8(text : string)                                        // Unload UTF-8 text encoded from codepoints array

def GetCodepointCount(text : string) : int                           // Get total number of codepoints in a UTF-8 encoded string
def GetCodepoint(text : string; codepointSize : int?) : int          // Get next codepoint in a UTF-8 encoded string, 0x3f('?') is returned on failure

def GetCodepointPrevious(text : string; codepointSize : int?) : int  // Get previous codepoint in a UTF-8 encoded string, 0x3f('?') is returned on failure
def CodepointToUTF8(codepoint : int; utf8Size : int?) : string       // Encode one codepoint into UTF-8 byte array (array length returned as parameter)

// Text strings management functions (no UTF-8 strings, only byte chars)

def LoadTextLines(text : string; count : int?) : string?                      // Load text as separate lines ('\n')
def UnloadTextLines(text : string?; lineCount : int)                          // Unload text lines

def GetTextBetween(text : string; begin : string; end : string) : string      // Get text between two strings
def TextReplace(text : string; search : string; replacement : string) : string  // Replace text string with new string
def TextReplaceAlloc(text : string; search : string; replacement : string) : string  // Replace text string with new string, memory must be MemFree()
def TextReplaceBetween(text : string; begin : string; end : string; replacement : string) : string  // Replace text between two specific strings
def TextReplaceBetweenAlloc(text : string; begin : string; end : string; replacement : string) : string  // Replace text between two specific strings, memory must be MemFree()
def TextInsert(text : string; insert : string; position : int) : string       // Insert text in a defined byte position
def TextInsertAlloc(text : string; insert : string; position : int) : string  // Insert text in a defined byte position, memory must be MemFree()
def TextJoin(textList : string?; count : int; delimiter : string) : string    // Join text strings with delimiter
def TextSplit(text : string; delimiter : int8; count : int?) : string?        // Split text into multiple strings, using MAX_TEXTSPLIT_COUNT static strings

def TextFindIndex(text : string; search : string) : int                       // Find first text occurrence within a string, -1 if not found

def TextToLower(text : string) : string                                       // Get lower case version of provided string
def TextToPascal(text : string) : string                                      // Get Pascal case notation version of provided string
def TextToSnake(text : string) : string                                       // Get Snake case notation version of provided string
def TextToCamel(text : string) : string                                       // Get Camel case notation version of provided string
def TextToInteger(text : string) : int                                        // Get integer value from text
def TextToFloat(text : string) : float                                        // Get float value from text

module: raudio

// Audio Loading and Playing Functions

// Audio device management functions
def InitAudioDevice()                // Initialize audio device and context
def CloseAudioDevice()               // Close the audio device and context
def IsAudioDeviceReady() : bool      // Check if audio device has been initialized successfully
def SetMasterVolume(volume : float)  // Set master volume (listener)
def GetMasterVolume() : float        // Get master volume (listener)

// Wave/Sound loading/unloading functions
def LoadWave(fileName : string) : Wave                          // Load wave data from file
def LoadWaveFromMemory(fileType : string; fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : Wave  // Load wave from memory buffer, fileType refers to extension: i.e. '.wav'
def IsWaveValid(wave : Wave) : bool                             // Check if wave data is valid (data loaded and parameters)
def LoadSound(fileName : string) : Sound                        // Load sound from file
def LoadSoundFromWave(wave : Wave) : Sound                      // Load sound from wave data
def LoadSoundAlias(source : Sound) : Sound                      // Load sound alias, new sound that shares the same sample data as the source sound, does not own the sound data
def IsSoundValid(sound : Sound) : bool                          // Check if sound is valid (data loaded and buffers initialized)
def UpdateSound(sound : Sound; data : void?; frameCount : int)  // Update sound buffer with new data (default data format: 32 bit float, stereo)
def UnloadWave(wave : Wave)                                     // Unload wave data
def UnloadSound(sound : Sound)                                  // Unload sound
def UnloadSoundAlias(alias : Sound)                             // Unload sound alias (does not deallocate sample data)
def ExportWave(wave : Wave; fileName : string) : bool           // Export wave data to file, returns true on success
def ExportWaveAsCode(wave : Wave; fileName : string) : bool     // Export wave sample data to code (.h), returns true on success

// Wave/Sound management functions
def PlaySound(sound : Sound)                                   // Play a sound
def StopSound(sound : Sound)                                   // Stop playing a sound
def PauseSound(sound : Sound)                                  // Pause a sound
def ResumeSound(sound : Sound)                                 // Resume a paused sound
def IsSoundPlaying(sound : Sound) : bool                       // Check if sound is currently playing
def SetSoundVolume(sound : Sound; volume : float)              // Set volume for a sound (1.0 is max level)
def SetSoundPitch(sound : Sound; pitch : float)                // Set pitch for a sound (1.0 is base level)
def SetSoundPan(sound : Sound; pan : float)                    // Set pan for a sound (-1.0 left, 0.0 center, 1.0 right)
def WaveCopy(wave : Wave) : Wave                               // Copy a wave to a new wave
def WaveCrop(wave : Wave?; initFrame : int; finalFrame : int)  // Crop a wave to defined frames range
def WaveFormat(wave : Wave?; sampleRate : int; sampleSize : int; channels : int)  // Convert wave data to desired format
def LoadWaveSamples(wave : Wave) : float?                      // Load samples data from wave as a 32bit float data array
def UnloadWaveSamples(samples : float?)                        // Unload samples data loaded with LoadWaveSamples()

// Music management functions
def LoadMusicStream(fileName : string) : Music        // Load music stream from file
def LoadMusicStreamFromMemory(fileType : string; data : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : Music  // Load music stream from data
def IsMusicValid(music : Music) : bool                // Check if music stream is valid (context and buffers initialized)
def UnloadMusicStream(music : Music)                  // Unload music stream
def PlayMusicStream(music : Music)                    // Start music playing
def IsMusicStreamPlaying(music : Music) : bool        // Check if music is playing
def UpdateMusicStream(music : Music)                  // Update buffers for music streaming
def StopMusicStream(music : Music)                    // Stop music playing
def PauseMusicStream(music : Music)                   // Pause music playing
def ResumeMusicStream(music : Music)                  // Resume playing paused music
def SeekMusicStream(music : Music; position : float)  // Seek music to a position (in seconds)
def SetMusicVolume(music : Music; volume : float)     // Set volume for music (1.0 is max level)
def SetMusicPitch(music : Music; pitch : float)       // Set pitch for music (1.0 is base level)
def SetMusicPan(music : Music; pan : float)           // Set pan for music (-1.0 left, 0.0 center, 1.0 right)
def GetMusicTimeLength(music : Music) : float         // Get music time length (in seconds)
def GetMusicTimePlayed(music : Music) : float         // Get current music time played (in seconds)

// AudioStream management functions
def LoadAudioStream(sampleRate : uint; sampleSize : uint; channels : uint) : AudioStream  // Load audio stream (to stream raw audio pcm data)

def UpdateAudioStream(stream : AudioStream; data : void?; frameCount : int)  // Update audio stream buffers with data
def IsAudioStreamProcessed(stream : AudioStream) : bool                      // Check if any audio stream buffers requires refill
def PlayAudioStream(stream : AudioStream)                                    // Play audio stream

def ResumeAudioStream(stream : AudioStream)                                  // Resume audio stream

def StopAudioStream(stream : AudioStream)                                    // Stop audio stream
def SetAudioStreamVolume(stream : AudioStream; volume : float)               // Set volume for audio stream (1.0 is max level)

def SetAudioStreamPan(stream : AudioStream; pan : float)                     // Set pan for audio stream (-1.0 left, 0.0 center, 1.0 right)
def SetAudioStreamBufferSizeDefault(size : int)                              // Default size for new audio streams

module: rshapes

// Basic Shapes Drawing Functions

// Set texture and rectangle to be used on shapes drawing
// NOTE: It can be useful when using basic shapes and one single font,
// defining a font char white rectangle would allow drawing everything in a single draw call
def SetShapesTexture(texture : Texture; rec : float4)  // Set texture and rectangle to be used on shapes drawing
def GetShapesTexture() : Texture                       // Get texture that is used for shapes drawing
def GetShapesTextureRectangle() : float4               // Get texture source rectangle that is used for shapes drawing

// Basic shapes drawing functions
def DrawPixel(posX : int; posY : int; color : float4)                         // Draw a pixel using geometry [Can be slow, use with care]
def DrawPixelV(position : float2; color : float4)                             // Draw a pixel using geometry (Vector version) [Can be slow, use with care]
def DrawLine(startPosX : int; startPosY : int; endPosX : int; endPosY : int; color : float4)  // Draw a line
def DrawLineV(startPos : float2; endPos : float2; color : float4)             // Draw a line (using gl lines)

// Texture Loading and Drawing Functions

// Image loading functions
// NOTE: These functions do not require GPU access
def LoadImage(fileName : string) : Image                        // Load image from file into CPU memory (RAM)
def LoadImageRaw(fileName : string; width : int; height : int; format : int; headerSize : int) : Image  // Load image from RAW file data
def LoadImageAnim(fileName : string; frames : int?) : Image     // Load image sequence from file (frames appended to image.data)
def LoadImageAnimFromMemory(fileType : string; fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int; frames : int?) : Image  // Load image sequence from memory buffer
def LoadImageFromMemory(fileType : string; fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : Image  // Load image from memory buffer, fileType refers to extension: i.e. '.png'
def LoadImageFromTexture(texture : Texture) : Image             // Load image from GPU texture data
def LoadImageFromScreen() : Image                               // Load image from screen buffer (screenshot)
def IsImageValid(image : Image) : bool                          // Check if an image is valid (data and parameters)
def UnloadImage(image : Image)                                  // Unload image from CPU memory (RAM)
def ExportImage(image : Image; fileName : string) : bool        // Export image data to file, returns true on success
def ExportImageToMemory(image : Image; fileType : string; fileSize : int?) : uint8?  // Export image to memory buffer, memory must be MemFree()
def ExportImageAsCode(image : Image; fileName : string) : bool  // Export image as code file defining an array of bytes, returns true on success

// Image generation functions
def GenImageColor(width : int; height : int; color : float4) : Image       // Generate image: plain color
def GenImageGradientLinear(width : int; height : int; direction : int; start : float4; end : float4) : Image  // Generate image: linear gradient, direction in degrees [0..360], 0=Vertical gradient
def GenImageGradientRadial(width : int; height : int; density : float; inner : float4; outer : float4) : Image  // Generate image: radial gradient
def GenImageGradientSquare(width : int; height : int; density : float; inner : float4; outer : float4) : Image  // Generate image: square gradient
def GenImageChecked(width : int; height : int; checksX : int; checksY : int; col1 : float4; col2 : float4) : Image  // Generate image: checked
def GenImageWhiteNoise(width : int; height : int; factor : float) : Image  // Generate image: white noise
def GenImagePerlinNoise(width : int; height : int; offsetX : int; offsetY : int; scale : float) : Image  // Generate image: perlin noise
def GenImageCellular(width : int; height : int; tileSize : int) : Image    // Generate image: cellular algorithm, bigger tileSize means bigger cells
def GenImageText(width : int; height : int; text : string) : Image         // Generate image: grayscale image from text data

// Image manipulation functions
def ImageCopy(image : Image) : Image                                     // Create an image duplicate (useful for transformations)
def ImageFromImage(image : Image; rec : float4) : Image                  // Create an image from another image piece
def ImageFromChannel(image : Image; selectedChannel : int) : Image       // Create an image from a selected channel of another image (GRAYSCALE)
def ImageText(text : string; fontSize : int; color : float4) : Image     // Create an image from text (default font)
def ImageTextEx(font : Font; text : string; fontSize : float; spacing : float; tint : float4) : Image  // Create an image from text (custom sprite font)
def ImageFormat(image : Image?; newFormat : int)                         // Convert image data to desired format
def ImageToPOT(image : Image?; fill : float4)                            // Convert image to POT (power-of-two)
def ImageCrop(image : Image?; crop : float4)                             // Crop an image to a defined rectangle
def ImageAlphaCrop(image : Image?; threshold : float)                    // Crop image depending on alpha value
def ImageAlphaClear(image : Image?; color : float4; threshold : float)   // Clear alpha channel to desired color
def ImageAlphaMask(image : Image?; alphaMask : Image)                    // Apply alpha mask to image
def ImageAlphaPremultiply(image : Image?)                                // Premultiply alpha channel
def ImageBlurGaussian(image : Image?; blurSize : int)                    // Apply Gaussian blur using a box blur approximation
def ImageKernelConvolution(image : Image?; kernel : float const?; kernelSize : int)  // Apply custom square convolution kernel to image
def ImageResize(image : Image?; newWidth : int; newHeight : int)         // Resize image (Bicubic scaling algorithm)
def ImageResizeNN(image : Image?; newWidth : int; newHeight : int)       // Resize image (Nearest-Neighbor scaling algorithm)
def ImageResizeCanvas(image : Image?; newWidth : int; newHeight : int; offsetX : int; offsetY : int; fill : float4)  // Resize canvas and fill with color
def ImageMipmaps(image : Image?)                                         // Compute all mipmap levels for a provided image
def ImageDither(image : Image?; rBpp : int; gBpp : int; bBpp : int; aBpp : int)  // Dither image data to 16bpp or lower (Floyd-Steinberg dithering)

def ImageColorGrayscale(image : Image?)                                  // Modify image color: grayscale
def ImageColorContrast(image : Image?; contrast : int)                   // Modify image color: contrast (-100 to 100)
def ImageColorBrightness(image : Image?; brightness : int)               // Modify image color: brightness (-255 to 255)

def UnloadImagePalette(colors : Color?)                                  // Unload colors palette loaded with LoadImagePalette()
def GetImageAlphaBorder(image : Image; threshold : float) : float4       // Get image alpha border rectangle
def GetImageColor(image : Image; x : int; y : int) : float4              // Get image pixel color at (x, y) position

// Image drawing functions
// NOTE: Image software-rendering functions (CPU)

def ImageDrawLineEx(dst : Image?; start : float2; end : float2; thick : int; color : float4)  // Draw a line defining thickness within an image
def ImageDrawLineStrip(dst : Image?; points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; color : float4)  // Draw a lines sequence within an image
def ImageDrawTriangle(dst : Image?; v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; color : float4)  // Draw triangle within an image
def ImageDrawTriangleGradient(dst : Image?; v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; c1 : float4; c2 : float4; c3 : float4)  // Draw triangle with interpolated colors within an image
def ImageDrawTriangleLines(dst : Image?; v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; color : float4)  // Draw triangle outline within an image
def ImageDrawTriangleFan(dst : Image?; points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; color : float4)  // Draw a triangle fan defined by points within an image (first vertex is the center)
def ImageDrawTriangleStrip(dst : Image?; points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; color : float4)  // Draw a triangle strip defined by points within an image
def ImageDrawRectangle(dst : Image?; posX : int; posY : int; width : int; height : int; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle within an image
def ImageDrawRectangleV(dst : Image?; position : float2; size : float2; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle within an image (Vector version)
def ImageDrawRectangleRec(dst : Image?; rec : float4; color : float4)     // Draw rectangle within an image
def ImageDrawRectanglePro(dst : Image?; rec : float4; origin : float2; rotation : float; color : float4)  // Draw a color-filled rectangle with pro parameters within and image
def ImageDrawRectangleLines(dst : Image?; posX : int; posY : int; width : int; height : int; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle lines within an image
def ImageDrawRectangleLinesEx(dst : Image?; rec : float4; thick : int; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle lines within an image with line thickness
def ImageDrawRectangleGradientEx(dst : Image?; rec : float4; col1 : float4; col2 : float4; col3 : float4; col4 : float4)  // Draw rectangle with gradient colors within an image, counter-clockwise color order
def ImageDrawCircle(dst : Image?; centerX : int; centerY : int; radius : int; color : float4)  // Draw a filled circle within an image
def ImageDrawCircleV(dst : Image?; center : float2; radius : int; color : float4)  // Draw a filled circle within an image (Vector version)
def ImageDrawCircleLines(dst : Image?; centerX : int; centerY : int; radius : int; color : float4)  // Draw circle outline within an image
def ImageDrawCircleLinesV(dst : Image?; center : float2; radius : int; color : float4)  // Draw circle outline within an image (Vector version)
def ImageDrawCircleGradient(dst : Image?; center : float2; radius : float; inner : float4; outer : float4)  // Draw a gradient-filled circle within an image
def ImageDrawImage(dst : Image?; src : Image; posX : int; posY : int; tint : float4)  // Draw an image within an image
def ImageDrawImageEx(dst : Image?; src : Image; position : float2; rotation : float; scale : float; tint : float4)  // Draw an image with scaling and rotation within an image
def ImageDrawImageRec(dst : Image?; src : Image; srcRec : float4; position : float2; tint : float4)  // Draw a part of an image defined by a rectangle within an image
def ImageDrawImagePro(dst : Image?; src : Image; srcRec : float4; dstRec : float4; origin : float2; rotation : float; tint : float4)  // Draw a part of an image defined by a rectangle into destination rectangle, with scaling and rotation, within an image
def ImageDrawText(dst : Image?; text : string; posX : int; posY : int; fontSize : int; color : float4)  // Draw text (using default font) within an image (destination)
def ImageDrawTextEx(dst : Image?; font : Font; text : string; position : float2; fontSize : float; spacing : float; tint : float4)  // Draw text (custom sprite font) within an image (destination)
def ImageDrawTextPro(dst : Image?; font : Font; text : string; position : float2; origin : float2; rotation : float; fontSize : float; spacing : float; tint : float4)  // Draw text using Font and pro parameters (rotation)

// Texture loading functions

def rlEnableDepthTest()                                       // Enable depth test

def rlDisableBackfaceCulling()                                // Disable backface culling

def rlEnableScissorTest()                                     // Enable scissor test
def rlDisableScissorTest()                                    // Disable scissor test
def rlScissor(x : int; y : int; width : int; height : int)    // Scissor test
def rlEnablePointMode()                                       // Enable point mode
def rlDisablePointMode()                                      // Disable point mode

def rlSetBlendFactorsSeparate(glSrcRGB : int; glDstRGB : int; glSrcAlpha : int; glDstAlpha : int; glEqRGB : int; glEqAlpha : int)  // Set blending mode factors and equations separately (using OpenGL factors)

// Functions Declaration - rlgl functionality
// rlgl initialization functions
def rlglInit(width : int; height : int)          // Initialize rlgl (buffers, shaders, textures, states)
def rlglClose()                                  // De-initialize rlgl (buffers, shaders, textures)
def rlLoadExtensions(loader : void?)             // Load OpenGL extensions (loader function required)
def rlGetProcAddress(procName : string) : void?  // Get OpenGL procedure address
def rlGetVersion() : int                         // Get current OpenGL version
def rlSetFramebufferWidth(width : int)           // Set current framebuffer width
def rlGetFramebufferWidth() : int                // Get default framebuffer width
def rlSetFramebufferHeight(height : int)         // Set current framebuffer height
def rlGetFramebufferHeight() : int               // Get default framebuffer height
def rlGetTextureIdDefault() : uint               // Get default texture id
def rlGetShaderIdDefault() : uint                // Get default shader id
def rlGetShaderLocsDefault() : int?              // Get default shader locations

// Render batch management
// NOTE: rlgl provides a default render batch to behave like OpenGL 1.1 immediate mode
// but this render batch API is exposed in case of custom batches are required
def rlLoadRenderBatch(numBuffers : int; bufferElements : int) : rlRenderBatch  // Load a render batch system
def rlUnloadRenderBatch(batch : rlRenderBatch)      // Unload render batch system
def rlDrawRenderBatch(batch : rlRenderBatch?)       // Draw render batch data (Update->Draw->Reset)
def rlSetRenderBatchActive(batch : rlRenderBatch?)  // Set the active render batch for rlgl (NULL for default internal)
def rlDrawRenderBatchActive()                       // Update and draw internal render batch
def rlCheckRenderBatchLimit(vCount : int) : bool    // Check internal buffer overflow for a given number of vertex
def rlSetTexture(id : uint)                         // Set current texture for render batch and check buffers limits

// Vertex buffers management
def rlLoadVertexArray() : uint                                              // Load vertex array (vao) if supported
def rlLoadVertexBuffer(buffer : void?; size : int; dynamic : bool) : uint   // Load a vertex buffer object
def rlLoadVertexBufferElement(buffer : void?; size : int; dynamic : bool) : uint  // Load vertex buffer elements object
def rlUpdateVertexBuffer(bufferId : uint; data : void?; dataSize : int; offset : int)  // Update vertex buffer object data on GPU buffer
def rlUpdateVertexBufferElements(id : uint; data : void?; dataSize : int; offset : int)  // Update vertex buffer elements data on GPU buffer
def rlUnloadVertexArray(vaoId : uint)                                       // Unload vertex array (vao)
def rlUnloadVertexBuffer(vboId : uint)                                      // Unload vertex buffer object
def rlSetVertexAttribute(index : uint; compSize : int; type : int; normalized : bool; stride : int; offset : int)  // Set vertex attribute data configuration
def rlSetVertexAttributeDivisor(index : uint; divisor : int)                // Set vertex attribute data divisor
def rlSetVertexAttributeDefault(locIndex : int; value : void?; attribType : int; count : int)  // Set vertex attribute default value, when attribute to provided
def rlDrawVertexArray(offset : int; count : int)                            // Draw vertex array (currently active vao)
def rlDrawVertexArrayElements(offset : int; count : int; buffer : void?)    // Draw vertex array elements
def rlDrawVertexArrayInstanced(offset : int; count : int; instances : int)  // Draw vertex array (currently active vao) with instancing
def rlDrawVertexArrayElementsInstanced(offset : int; count : int; buffer : void?; instances : int)  // Draw vertex array elements with instancing

// Textures management
def rlLoadTexture(data : void?; width : int; height : int; format : int; mipmapCount : int) : uint  // Load texture data
def rlLoadTextureDepth(width : int; height : int; useRenderBuffer : bool) : uint  // Load depth texture/renderbuffer (to be attached to fbo)
def rlLoadTextureCubemap(data : void?; size : int; format : int; mipmapCount : int) : uint  // Load texture cubemap data
def rlUpdateTexture(id : uint; offsetX : int; offsetY : int; width : int; height : int; format : int; data : void?)  // Update texture with new data on GPU
def rlGetGlTextureFormats(format : int; glInternalFormat : uint?; glFormat : uint?; glType : uint?)  // Get OpenGL internal formats
def rlGetPixelFormatName(format : uint) : string            // Get name string for pixel format
def rlUnloadTexture(id : uint)                              // Unload texture from GPU memory
def rlGenTextureMipmaps(id : uint; width : int; height : int; format : int; mipmaps : int?)  // Generate mipmap data for selected texture
def rlReadTexturePixels(id : uint; width : int; height : int; format : int) : void?  // Read texture pixel data
def rlReadScreenPixels(width : int; height : int) : uint8?  // Read screen pixel data (color buffer)

// Framebuffer management (fbo)
def rlLoadFramebuffer() : uint               // Load an empty framebuffer
def rlFramebufferAttach(id : uint; texId : uint; attachType : int; texType : int; mipLevel : int)  // Attach texture/renderbuffer to a framebuffer
def rlFramebufferComplete(id : uint) : bool  // Verify framebuffer is complete
def rlUnloadFramebuffer(id : uint)           // Delete framebuffer from GPU

// WARNING: Copy and resize framebuffer functionality only defined for software backend
def rlCopyFramebuffer(x : int; y : int; width : int; height : int; format : int; pixels : void?)  // Copy framebuffer pixel data to internal buffer
def rlResizeFramebuffer(width : int; height : int)  // Resize internal framebuffer

// Shaders management
def rlLoadShader(code : string; type : int) : uint                          // Load (compile) shader and return shader id (type: RL_VERTEX_SHADER, RL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, RL_COMPUTE_SHADER)
def rlLoadShaderProgram(vsCode : string; fsCode : string) : uint            // Load shader from code strings
def rlLoadShaderProgramEx(vsId : uint; fsId : uint) : uint                  // Load shader program, using already loaded shader ids
def rlLoadShaderProgramCompute(csId : uint) : uint                          // Load compute shader program
def rlUnloadShader(id : uint)                                               // Unload shader, loaded with rlLoadShader()
def rlUnloadShaderProgram(id : uint)                                        // Unload shader program
def rlGetLocationUniform(id : uint; uniformName : string) : int             // Get shader location uniform, requires shader program id
def rlGetLocationAttrib(id : uint; attribName : string) : int               // Get shader location attribute, requires shader program id
def rlSetUniform(locIndex : int; value : void?; uniformType : int; count : int)  // Set shader value uniform
def rlSetUniformMatrix(locIndex : int; mat : float4x4)                      // Set shader value matrix
def rlSetUniformMatrices(locIndex : int; mat : Matrix const?; count : int)  // Set shader value matrices
def rlSetUniformSampler(locIndex : int; textureId : uint)                   // Set shader value sampler
def rlSetShader(id : uint; locs : int?)                                     // Set shader currently active (id and locations)

// Compute shader management
def rlComputeShaderDispatch(groupX : uint; groupY : uint; groupZ : uint)  // Dispatch compute shader (equivalent to *draw* for graphics pipeline)

// Shader buffer storage object management (ssbo)
def rlLoadShaderBuffer(size : uint; data : void?; usageHint : int) : uint     // Load shader storage buffer object (SSBO)
def rlUnloadShaderBuffer(ssboId : uint)                                       // Unload shader storage buffer object (SSBO)
def rlUpdateShaderBuffer(id : uint; data : void?; dataSize : uint; offset : uint)  // Update SSBO buffer data
def rlBindShaderBuffer(id : uint; index : uint)                               // Bind SSBO buffer
def rlReadShaderBuffer(id : uint; dest : void?; count : uint; offset : uint)  // Read SSBO buffer data (GPU->CPU)
def rlCopyShaderBuffer(destId : uint; srcId : uint; destOffset : uint; srcOffset : uint; count : uint)  // Copy SSBO data between buffers
def rlGetShaderBufferSize(id : uint) : uint                                   // Get SSBO buffer size

// Buffer management
def rlBindImageTexture(id : uint; index : uint; format : int; readonly : bool)  // Bind image texture

// Matrix state management
def rlGetMatrixModelview() : float4x4                               // Get internal modelview matrix
def rlGetMatrixProjection() : float4x4                              // Get internal projection matrix
def rlGetMatrixTransform() : float4x4                               // Get internal accumulated transform matrix
def rlGetMatrixProjectionStereo(eye : int) : float4x4               // Get internal projection matrix for stereo render (selected eye)
def rlGetMatrixViewOffsetStereo(eye : int) : float4x4               // Get internal view offset matrix for stereo render (selected eye)
def rlSetMatrixProjection(proj : float4x4)                          // Set a custom projection matrix (replaces internal projection matrix)
def rlSetMatrixModelview(view : float4x4)                           // Set a custom modelview matrix (replaces internal modelview matrix)
def rlSetMatrixProjectionStereo(right : float4x4; left : float4x4)  // Set eyes projection matrices for stereo rendering
def rlSetMatrixViewOffsetStereo(right : float4x4; left : float4x4)  // Set eyes view offsets matrices for stereo rendering

// Quick and dirty cube/quad buffers load->draw->unload
def rlLoadDrawCube()  // Load and draw a cube
def rlLoadDrawQuad()  // Load and draw a quad

module: raygui

// Global gui state control functions
def GuiEnable()                 // Enable gui controls (global state)
def GuiDisable()                // Disable gui controls (global state)
def GuiLock()                   // Lock gui controls (global state)
def GuiUnlock()                 // Unlock gui controls (global state)
def GuiIsLocked() : bool        // Check if gui is locked (global state)
def GuiSetAlpha(alpha : float)  // Set gui controls alpha (global state), alpha goes from 0.0f to 1.0f
def GuiSetState(state : int)    // Set gui state (global state)
def GuiGetState() : int         // Get gui state (global state)

// Font set/get functions
def GuiSetFont(font : Font)  // Set gui custom font (global state)
def GuiGetFont() : Font      // Get gui custom font (global state)

// Style set/get functions
def GuiSetStyle(control : int; property : int; value : int)  // Set one style property
def GuiGetStyle(control : int; property : int) : int         // Get one style property

// Styles loading functions
def GuiLoadStyle(fileName : string)                                  // Load style file over global style variable (.rgs)
def GuiLoadStyleFromMemory(fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int)  // Load style from memory (binary only)
def GuiLoadStyleDefault()                                            // Load style default over global style

// Tooltips management functions
def GuiEnableTooltip()               // Enable gui tooltips (global state)
def GuiDisableTooltip()              // Disable gui tooltips (global state)
def GuiSetTooltip(tooltip : string)  // Set tooltip string

// Icons functionality
def GuiIconText(iconId : int; text : string) : string                // Get text with icon id prepended (if supported)
def GuiSetIconScale(scale : int)                                     // Set default icon drawing size
def GuiGetIcons() : uint?                                            // Get raygui icons data pointer
def GuiLoadIcons(fileName : string; loadIconsName : bool) : string?  // Load raygui icons file (.rgi) into internal icons data
def GuiLoadIconsFromMemory(fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int; loadIconsName : bool) : string?  // Load raygui icons file (.rgi) from memory into internal icons data
def GuiDrawIcon(iconId : int; posX : int; posY : int; pixelSize : int; color : float4)  // Draw icon using pixel size at specified position

// Utility functions
def GuiGetTextWidth(text : string) : int  // Get text width considering gui style and icon size (if required)

// Controls
// Container/separator controls, useful for controls organization
def GuiWindowBox(bounds : float4; title : string) : int  // Window Box control, shows a window that can be closed
def GuiGroupBox(bounds : float4; text : string) : int    // Group Box control with text name
def GuiLine(bounds : float4; text : string) : int        // Line separator control, could contain text
def GuiPanel(bounds : float4; text : string) : int       // Panel control, useful to group controls
def GuiScrollPanel(bounds : float4; text : string; content : float4; scroll : float2?; view : float4?) : int  // Scroll Panel control

// Basic controls set
def GuiLabel(bounds : float4; text : string) : int                           // Label control
def GuiButton(bounds : float4; text : string) : int                          // Button control, returns true when clicked
def GuiLabelButton(bounds : float4; text : string) : int                     // Label button control, returns true when clicked
def GuiToggle(bounds : float4; text : string; active : bool?) : int          // Toggle Button control
def GuiToggleGroup(bounds : float4; text : string; active : int?) : int      // Toggle Group control
def GuiToggleSlider(bounds : float4; text : string; active : int?) : int     // Toggle Slider control
def GuiCheckBox(bounds : float4; text : string; checked : bool?) : int       // Check Box control, returns true when active
def GuiComboBox(bounds : float4; text : string; active : int?) : int         // Combo Box control
def GuiDropdownBox(bounds : float4; text : string; active : int?; editMode : bool) : int  // Dropdown Box control
def GuiSpinner(bounds : float4; text : string; value : int?; minValue : int; maxValue : int; editMode : bool) : int  // Spinner control
def GuiValueBox(bounds : float4; text : string; value : int?; minValue : int; maxValue : int; editMode : bool) : int  // Value Box control, updates input text with numbers
def GuiValueBoxFloat(bounds : float4; text : string; textValue : string; value : float?; editMode : bool) : int  // Value box control for float values
def GuiTextBox(bounds : float4; text : string; textSize : int; editMode : bool) : int  // Text Box control, updates input text
def GuiTextBox(bounds : float4; text : array<uint8>; editMode : bool) : int  // raylib_boost overload, takes the enum directly
def GuiSlider(bounds : float4; textLeft : string; textRight : string; value : float?; minValue : float; maxValue : float) : int  // Slider control
def GuiSliderBar(bounds : float4; textLeft : string; textRight : string; value : float?; minValue : float; maxValue : float) : int  // Slider Bar control
def GuiProgressBar(bounds : float4; textLeft : string; textRight : string; value : float?; minValue : float; maxValue : float) : int  // Progress Bar control
def GuiStatusBar(bounds : float4; text : string) : int                       // Status Bar control, shows info text
def GuiDummyRec(bounds : float4; text : string) : int                        // Dummy control for placeholders
def GuiGrid(bounds : float4; text : string; spacing : float; subdivs : int; mouseCell : float2?) : int  // Grid control

// Advance controls set
def GuiListView(bounds : float4; text : string; scrollIndex : int?; active : int?) : int  // List View control
def GuiListViewEx(bounds : float4; text : string?; count : int; scrollIndex : int?; active : int?; focus : int?) : int  // List View control, using text entries list and returning focus entry
def GuiListViewEx(bounds : float4; items : array<string>; scrollIndex : int?; active : int?; focus : int?) : int  // raylib_boost overload, takes the enum directly
def GuiTabBar(bounds : float4; text : string; hscroll : int?; active : int?) : int  // Tab Bar control
def GuiTabBarEx(bounds : float4; text : string?; count : int; hscroll : int?; active : int?; focus : int?) : int  // Tab Bar control, using text entries list and returning focus entry
def GuiMessageBox(bounds : float4; title : string; message : string; btnText : string; btnActive : int?) : int  // Message Box control, displays a message
def GuiTextInputBox(bounds : float4; title : string; message : string; text : string; textSize : int; btnText : string; btnActive : int?; secretViewActive : bool?) : int  // Text Input Box control, ask for text, supports secret
def GuiTextInputBox(bounds : float4; title : string; message : string; text : array<uint8>; btnText : string; btnActive : int?; secretViewActive : bool?) : int  // raylib_boost overload, takes the enum directly
def GuiColorPicker(bounds : float4; text : string; color : Color?) : int    // Color Picker control, includes Color bar controls
def GuiColorPanel(bounds : float4; text : string; color : Color?) : int     // Color Panel control
def GuiColorBarAlpha(bounds : float4; text : string; alpha : float?) : int  // Color Bar Alpha control
def GuiColorBarHue(bounds : float4; text : string; value : float?) : int    // Color Bar Hue control
def GuiColorPickerHSV(bounds : float4; text : string; colorHsv : float3?) : int  // Color Picker control, using Hue-Saturation-Value color data, includes Color bar controls
def GuiColorPanelHSV(bounds : float4; text : string; colorHsv : float3?) : int  // Color Panel control, using Hue-Saturation-Value color data

structs

struct Matrix    // Matrix, 4x4 components, column major, OpenGL style, right-handed
    m0 : float   // Matrix first row (4 components)
    m4 : float   // Matrix first row (4 components)
    m8 : float   // Matrix first row (4 components)
    m12 : float  // Matrix first row (4 components)
    m1 : float   // Matrix second row (4 components)
    m5 : float   // Matrix second row (4 components)
    m9 : float   // Matrix second row (4 components)
    m13 : float  // Matrix second row (4 components)
    m2 : float   // Matrix third row (4 components)
    m6 : float   // Matrix third row (4 components)
    m10 : float  // Matrix third row (4 components)
    m14 : float  // Matrix third row (4 components)
    m3 : float   // Matrix fourth row (4 components)
    m7 : float   // Matrix fourth row (4 components)
    m11 : float  // Matrix fourth row (4 components)
    m15 : float  // Matrix fourth row (4 components)

struct Color   // Color, 4 components, R8G8B8A8 (32bit)
    r : uint8  // Color red value
    g : uint8  // Color green value
    b : uint8  // Color blue value
    a : uint8  // Color alpha value

struct Image       // Image, pixel data stored in CPU memory (RAM)
    data : void?   // Image raw data
    width : int    // Image base width
    height : int   // Image base height
    mipmaps : int  // Mipmap levels, 1 by default
    format : int   // Data format (PixelFormat type)

struct Texture     // Texture, tex data stored in GPU memory (VRAM)
    id : uint      // OpenGL texture id
    width : int    // Texture base width
    height : int   // Texture base height
    mipmaps : int  // Mipmap levels, 1 by default
    format : int   // Data format (PixelFormat type)

struct RenderTexture   // RenderTexture, fbo for texture rendering
    id : uint          // OpenGL framebuffer object id
    texture : Texture  // Color buffer attachment texture
    depth : Texture    // Depth buffer attachment texture

struct NPatchInfo    // NPatchInfo, n-patch layout info
    source : float4  // Texture source rectangle
    left : int       // Left border offset
    top : int        // Top border offset
    right : int      // Right border offset
    bottom : int     // Bottom border offset
    layout : int     // Layout of the n-patch: 3x3, 1x3 or 3x1

struct GlyphInfo    // GlyphInfo, font characters glyphs info
    value : int     // Character value (Unicode)
    offsetX : int   // Character offset X when drawing
    offsetY : int   // Character offset Y when drawing
    advanceX : int  // Character advance position X
    image : Image   // Character image data

struct Font              // Font, font texture and GlyphInfo array data
    baseSize : int       // Base size (default chars height)
    glyphCount : int     // Number of glyph characters
    glyphPadding : int   // Padding around the glyph characters
    texture : Texture    // Texture atlas containing the glyphs
    recs : float4?       // Rectangles in texture for the glyphs
    glyphs : GlyphInfo?  // Glyphs info data

struct Camera3D        // Camera, defines position/orientation in 3d space
    position : float3  // Camera position
    target : float3    // Camera target it looks-at
    up : float3        // Camera up vector (rotation over its axis)
    fovy : float       // Camera field-of-view aperture in Y (degrees) in perspective, used as near plane height in world units in orthographic
    projection : int   // Camera projection: CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE or CAMERA_ORTHOGRAPHIC

struct Camera2D       // Camera2D, defines position/orientation in 2d space
    offset : float2   // Camera offset (screen space offset from window origin, unscaled by DPI, real pixel size)
    target : float2   // Camera target (world space target point that is mapped to screen space offset)
    rotation : float  // Camera rotation in degrees (pivots around target)
    zoom : float      // Camera zoom (scaling around target), must not be set to 0, set to 1.0f for no scale

struct Mesh                // Mesh, vertex data and vao/vbo
    vertexCount : int      // Number of vertices stored in arrays
    triangleCount : int    // Number of triangles stored (indexed or not)
    vertices : float?      // Vertex position (XYZ - 3 components per vertex) (shader-location = 0)
    texcoords : float?     // Vertex texture coordinates (UV - 2 components per vertex) (shader-location = 1)
    texcoords2 : float?    // Vertex texture second coordinates (UV - 2 components per vertex) (shader-location = 5)
    normals : float?       // Vertex normals (XYZ - 3 components per vertex) (shader-location = 2)
    tangents : float?      // Vertex tangents (XYZW - 4 components per vertex) (shader-location = 4)
    colors : uint8?        // Vertex colors (RGBA - 4 components per vertex) (shader-location = 3)
    indices : uint16?      // Vertex indices (in case vertex data comes indexed)
    boneCount : int        // Number of bones (MAX: 256 bones)
    boneIndices : uint8?   // Vertex bone indices, up to 4 bones influence by vertex (skinning) (shader-location = 6)
    boneWeights : float?   // Vertex bone weight, up to 4 bones influence by vertex (skinning) (shader-location = 7)
    animVertices : float?  // Animated vertex positions (after bones transformations)
    animNormals : float?   // Animated normals (after bones transformations)
    vaoId : uint           // OpenGL Vertex Array Object id
    vboId : uint?          // OpenGL Vertex Buffer Objects id (default vertex data)

struct Shader    // Shader
    id : uint    // Shader program id
    locs : int?  // Shader locations array (RL_MAX_SHADER_LOCATIONS)

struct MaterialMap     // MaterialMap
    texture : Texture  // Material map texture
    color : Color      // Material map color
    value : float      // Material map value

struct Material          // Material, includes shader and maps
    shader : Shader      // Material shader
    maps : MaterialMap?  // Material maps array (MAX_MATERIAL_MAPS)
    params : float[4]    // Material generic parameters (if required)

struct Transform          // Transform, vertex transformation data
    translation : float3  // Translation
    rotation : float4     // Rotation
    scale : float3        // Scale

struct BoneInfo      // Bone, skeletal animation bone
    name : int8[32]  // Bone name
    parent : int     // Bone parent

struct ModelSkeleton       // Skeleton, animation bones hierarchy
    boneCount : uint       // Number of bones
    bones : BoneInfo?      // Bones information (skeleton)
    bindPose : Transform?  // Bones base transformation (Transform[])

struct Model                  // Model, meshes, materials and animation data
    transform : Matrix        // Local transform matrix
    meshCount : int           // Number of meshes
    materialCount : int       // Number of materials
    meshes : Mesh?            // Meshes array
    materials : Material?     // Materials array
    meshMaterial : int?       // Mesh material number
    skeleton : ModelSkeleton  // Skeleton for animation
    currentPose : Transform?  // Current animation pose (Transform[])
    boneMatrices : Matrix?    // Bones animated transformation matrices

struct ModelAnimation            // ModelAnimation, contains a full animation sequence
    name : int8[32]              // Animation name
    boneCount : uint             // Number of bones (per pose)
    keyframeCount : int          // Number of animation key frames
    keyframePoses : Transform??  // Animation sequence keyframe poses [keyframe][pose]

struct Ray              // Ray, ray for raycasting
    position : float3   // Ray position (origin)
    direction : float3  // Ray direction (normalized)

struct RayCollision   // RayCollision, ray hit information
    hit : bool        // Did the ray hit something?
    distance : float  // Distance to the nearest hit
    point : float3    // Point of the nearest hit
    normal : float3   // Surface normal of hit

struct BoundingBox  // BoundingBox
    min : float3    // Minimum vertex box-corner
    max : float3    // Maximum vertex box-corner

struct Wave            // Wave, audio wave data
    frameCount : uint  // Total number of frames (considering channels)
    sampleRate : uint  // Frequency (samples per second)
    sampleSize : uint  // Bit depth (bits per sample): 8, 16, 32 (24 not supported)
    channels : uint    // Number of channels (1-mono, 2-stereo, ...)
    data : void?       // Buffer data pointer

struct AudioStream                // AudioStream, custom audio stream
    buffer : rAudioBuffer?        // Pointer to internal data used by the audio system
    processor : rAudioProcessor?  // Pointer to internal data processor, useful for audio effects
    sampleRate : uint             // Frequency (samples per second)
    sampleSize : uint             // Bit depth (bits per sample): 8, 16, 32 (24 not supported)
    channels : uint               // Number of channels (1-mono, 2-stereo, ...)

struct Sound              // Sound
    stream : AudioStream  // Audio stream
    frameCount : uint     // Total number of frames (considering channels)

struct Music              // Music, audio stream, anything longer than ~10 seconds should be streamed
    stream : AudioStream  // Audio stream
    frameCount : uint     // Total number of frames (considering channels)
    looping : bool        // Music looping enable
    ctxType : int         // Type of music context (audio filetype)
    ctxData : void?       // Audio context data, depends on type

struct VrDeviceInfo                  // VrDeviceInfo, Head-Mounted-Display device parameters
    hResolution : int                // Horizontal resolution in pixels
    vResolution : int                // Vertical resolution in pixels
    hScreenSize : float              // Horizontal size in meters
    vScreenSize : float              // Vertical size in meters
    eyeToScreenDistance : float      // Distance between eye and display in meters
    lensSeparationDistance : float   // Lens separation distance in meters
    interpupillaryDistance : float   // IPD (distance between pupils) in meters
    lensDistortionValues : float[4]  // Lens distortion constant parameters
    chromaAbCorrection : float[4]    // Chromatic aberration correction parameters

struct VrStereoConfig             // VrStereoConfig, VR stereo rendering configuration for simulator
    projection : Matrix[2]        // VR projection matrices (per eye)

    leftScreenCenter : float[2]   // VR left screen center
    rightScreenCenter : float[2]  // VR right screen center
